review_evidence: The 973 formal-source files include hardware/IP specifications and proof modules; Examples/FPU/Proofs.lean states IEEE-754 hardware theorems and IP/BitNet/Proof/DotProductCorrectness.lean contains source-owned correctness theorems.
Examples, simulation, and benchmark roles are retained by default because this repository demonstrably places formal specifications and proofs under those paths.
Both selected lakefile.lean files were inspected directly and contain Lake package/library/executable/linker/FFI configuration rather than Sparkle hardware semantics or verification statements.

rules.content_invariant: All Sparkle HDL definitions, IP implementations, specifications, examples, and theorem/proof modules remain retained; removing these two inspected build files cannot hide a unique hardware specification, theorem, proof, or reusable formal interface.
evidence: The root lakefile is a large build/link orchestration file containing package, require, extern_lib, lean_lib, executable and platform linker setup.
Examples/FPU/old/lakefile.lean only declares the sparkle-fpu package, Sparkle dependency, FPU library target, and fpu-sim-test executable.
rules.rationale: These exact Lake DSL files configure packages, libraries, executables, FFI archives, and linker behavior rather than defining Sparkle hardware semantics or verification results.

summary: Reviewed Sparkle; retain the HDL, hardware specifications, verification proofs, IP libraries, and examples, excluding only two inspected Lake build-configuration files.
